name: Repair-First

intent_defaults.description: A garment architecture that makes likely wear points inspectable and replacement or repair practical.
intent_defaults.silhouette: User-selectable, with reinforcement and replacement access considered early

component_defaults.panels: Use replaceable panels only where the interface is robust and visually intentional

accessibility_defaults: Repair steps and replacement parts should be understandable to the intended wearer or maker.
circularity_defaults: Document replaceable components, tools, repair methods and compatible replacement materials.
caveats: Repairability is design intent until repair tasks are physically tried and timed.
Durability and service life require testing under a declared wear, care and repair profile.
